defect.evidence_quote: When a prosecutor seeks to rely upon consent to justify the lawfulness of a search, he has the burden of proving that the consent was, in fact, freely and voluntarily given.[12] This burden cannot be discharged by *549 showing no more than acquiescence to a claim of lawful authority.[13]
defect.locator_note: lake pinpoints id pin-548; content_page.md uses pin-548 for the 391 U.S. at 548-549 rule quote, but the lake quote is copied from surrounding generated page text instead.
defect.problem: pin-548's stored quote is not the opinion passage for the 548-549 rule quote. It is a generated fragment from the built page background/issue/rule text and does not match the cached opinion text at the cited pages.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace lake pinpoints[pin-548].quote with the actual 548-549 rule passage beginning 'When a prosecutor seeks to rely upon consent...' and remove the generated content-page fragment.

reasons: The payload quote begins 'and let them in...' and includes markdown headings '## Issue' and '## Rule No.', which are not the opinion's quoted rule passage.
The cached opinion text at 548-549 contains the prosecutor-burden/acquiescence passage, not the payload fragment.
The lake record itself flags pin-548 quote_fidelity as mismatch and has no page/star position.
residual_risks: The content-page rule quote itself appears supported by the cached opinion; the defect is the lake pinpoint quote bound to that pin.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep generated background/issue prose out of pinpoint quote fields; pin-548 should store only authority text.

defect.evidence_quote: When a law enforcement officer claims authority to search a home under a warrant, he announces in effect that the occupant has no right to resist the search. The situation is instinct with coercion\u0097albeit colorably lawful coercion. Where there is coercion there cannot be consent.
defect.locator_note: text/Bumper v. North Carolina__f1e84d.txt line containing the page-550 passage; lake pinpoints id pin-550.
defect.problem: The pin-550 quote is substantively the right passage, but it is not character-faithful to the cached text because the dash/spacing differs: the text has 'coercion\u0097albeit' while the stored/content quote has 'coercion — albeit'.
defect.proposed_fix: Either store the quote exactly as the cached text renders it, or mark it as normalized rather than exact verbatim quotation.

reasons: The quoted sentence sequence appears at the page-550 passage in the cached opinion text.
The only disclosed mismatch is typographic/spacing around the dash, but strict quote fidelity requires character-faithful text.
The lake record flags pin-550 quote_fidelity as mismatch.
residual_risks: If the corpus intentionally normalizes mojibake dash characters, it needs an explicit normalized-quote flag; otherwise exact quote checks will continue to fail.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Normalize source text and stored quotes through the same pipeline, or separate exact_quote from display_quote.
